name: Git
shortDescription: Git keeps a history of changes to files. It helps you compare versions and work on ideas without losing the story of how a project grew.
highlights: Learn about inspect the working tree
Learn about read the history
Learn about inspect remotes

name: GitHub
shortDescription: GitHub hosts Git projects and tools for working together. Learn repository pages, issues, pull requests and checks through written examples that need no account.
highlights: Learn about follow the github flow
Learn about understand review outcomes
Learn about explain a version with a release

name: GitLab
shortDescription: GitLab brings project code, issues, reviews and pipelines together. Learn groups, merge requests, issue boards and checks through small worked plans with clear limits.
highlights: Learn about use labels to organise issues
Learn about resolve review discussions
Learn about use protected branches and merge checks

name: Linux
shortDescription: Linux is an operating system used on many computers and servers. A shell reads typed commands. We will practise safe commands in a folder made only for these lessons.
highlights: Learn about create and enter a folder
Learn about search lines
Learn about see running processes

name: Docker
shortDescription: Docker packages programs and their needed files into images. Containers run from those images. We will inspect small examples and practise only on a local learning machine.
highlights: Learn about see local images
Learn about inspect container details
Learn about volumes store data outside a container

name: Kubernetes
shortDescription: Kubernetes manages groups of containers. We will learn Pods, Deployments and Services by reading small configuration files and safe inspection commands.
highlights: Learn about pods hold containers
Learn about services give a stable route
Learn about read logs and rollout state

name: Jenkins
shortDescription: Jenkins automates repeatable project jobs. We will read small Jenkinsfile examples and learn stages, agents, parameters and clear results without setting up a production automation service.
highlights: Learn about stages show the journey
Learn about conditions skip unneeded stages
Learn about credentials stay outside source

name: GitHub Actions
shortDescription: GitHub Actions runs automated jobs for GitHub projects. We will read small workflow files and learn events, jobs, runners and safe permissions without publishing or deploying anything.
highlights: Learn about jobs and steps
Learn about job dependencies
Learn about avoid duplicate obsolete runs

name: Terraform
shortDescription: Terraform describes desired infrastructure in configuration files. We will use a built-in local example to learn variables, plans, state and careful review without creating cloud resources.
highlights: Learn about initialise the folder
Learn about read a plan
Learn about modules package configuration

name: AWS
shortDescription: AWS offers cloud computing, storage and networking services. Learn the names of the main parts, read a simple static-site plan and understand access and cost before creating anything.
highlights: Learn about identity and access with iam
Learn about vpcs and subnets
Learn about budgets are alerts

name: Microsoft Azure
shortDescription: Azure provides cloud services from Microsoft. Learn subscriptions, resource groups, identities, storage and networking with small worked plans and no real deployment.
highlights: Learn about regions and availability
Learn about static website files
Learn about azure monitor helps you observe

name: Google Cloud Platform
shortDescription: Google Cloud offers projects, storage, virtual machines and network tools. Learn the main ideas through fictional plans and simple checks before considering any real resources.
highlights: Learn about regions and zones
Learn about object versions and lifecycle rules
Learn about logging and monitoring

name: Nginx
shortDescription: Nginx can deliver static website files. Learn request paths, configuration blocks, content types, caching and error pages by reading small examples for a local practice setup.
highlights: Learn about document roots
Learn about use a helpful error page
Learn about https protects the connection

name: Apache HTTP Server
shortDescription: Apache HTTP Server can serve static web pages and assets. Learn virtual hosts, directory access, content types, modules and error pages through simple configuration examples.
highlights: Learn about virtual hosts choose a site
Learn about mime types describe files
Learn about logs explain requests and problems

name: Postman
shortDescription: Postman helps people inspect and test HTTP requests. Learn methods, URLs, status codes, JSON and response checks through worked messages that do not need a live API.
highlights: Learn about get reads a resource
Learn about read json safely
Learn about check a response field

name: VS Code
shortDescription: Visual Studio Code helps you edit project files. Learn folders, search, formatting, settings and safe terminal use through a small static-page workspace.
highlights: Learn about use the command palette
Learn about replace with a preview
Learn about extensions and workspace trust
